name: GridSpace
tagline: A local-first spreadsheet with a real C# engine and dynamic arrays
summary: GridSpace is a local-first spreadsheet workbench that pairs an Excel-style ribbon, formula bar and worksheet tabs with a real C# workbook engine. The worksheet is drawn by SkiaSharp through Uno's SKCanvasElement—not an HTML table or a separate JavaScript spreadsheet—and desktop and browser hosts share the same model, calculations, transactions and controls. Version 0.3 adds spilling dynamic arrays and delta-based cell history.

highlights.title: A real workbook engine
highlights.text: Parser, evaluator, transactions and history in C#, rendered by SkiaSharp through Uno's SKCanvasElement—no HTML table or JavaScript spreadsheet.

highlights.title: Spilling dynamic arrays
highlights.text: SEQUENCE, FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, stacking functions, LET, array constants, broadcasting and A1# references spill through the real worksheet.

highlights.title: Conditional formatting
highlights.text: Eleven rule kinds with relative formulas, priorities and Stop If True, plus two/three-color scales and signed data bars.

highlights.title: Filter and sort
highlights.text: A searchable value checklist, And/Or custom predicates with wildcards, and stable multi-level sorts with blank-last ordering.

highlights.title: Structural edits that follow
highlights.text: Insert or delete rows and columns while formulas, names, merges, validation, charts and rules are rebased in one transaction.

highlights.title: Sparse, fast viewport
highlights.text: Render through XFD1048576 with frozen panes and hidden rows, and dependency-based recalculation that only touches affected cells.

highlights.title: Charts
highlights.text: Single-series column, bar, line and pie charts with bounded previews and XLSX chart interchange.

highlights.title: Honest XLSX interchange
highlights.text: Native .gridspace, CSV/TSV and a documented XLSX subset, with import warnings and Open XML SDK schema validation in CI.

items: Sparse worksheets with A1 navigation and rectangular selection
Direct cell and formula-bar editing with copy/paste
Bounded undo/redo using per-cell deltas
Fill down/right, formula translation and two-value series
Fonts, wrapping, alignment, borders, merges, row/column sizing and AutoFit
Relative, absolute, mixed and cross-sheet references plus names
Common aggregates, logic, math, text/date, conditional aggregates, lookups and PMT
SEQUENCE, FILTER, SORT, SORTBY, UNIQUE, TRANSPOSE, TAKE, DROP and more
LET, array constants, broadcasting and A1# spill references
#SPILL! and #CYCLE! errors with protected spill followers
Cell comparisons, formula expressions, contains-text and duplicate/unique rules
Top/bottom and above/below-average rules
Two/three-color scales and signed data bars
Manage Rules to edit, delete and reorder with Stop If True
Searchable value checklist in the filter-header popup
One or two custom predicates with And/Or and * ? ~ wildcards
Manual hiding kept separate from filtered-out rows
Stable multi-level sorts with header and case options
Multi-row/column insertion and deletion with transactional rebasing
Frozen panes, hidden-row/column geometry and zoom
Wheel scrolling, touch panning and keyboard navigation
Worksheet insert, copy, rename, delete and manual hide/unhide
Find and replace
List validation and plain cell notes
Styled table ranges with AutoFilter metadata
Column, bar, line and pie charts
Native .gridspace JSON with conditional/filter/sort metadata
CSV/TSV with formula-injection guards on export
XLSX subset including dynamic-array metadata and chart interchange
Debounced IndexedDB recovery in the browser; atomic recovery file on desktop

playground.intro: The live browser build opens a sample model with Revenue, Assumptions and Read me sheets—edit inputs and watch the C# engine recalculate.

tour.title: Recalculate the model
tour.text: Change Revenue!D6 or a value on the Assumptions sheet and watch dependent cells update.

tour.title: Add data bars
tour.text: Select D6:D17 and choose Data → Data Bars, then open Data → Manage Rules to edit or reorder the rule.

tour.title: Filter a table
tour.text: Click a table's filter-header button to search the value checklist or build a custom And/Or condition.

tour.title: Sort by several columns
tour.text: Select the data and choose Data → Custom Sort to add, reorder and remove sort levels.

tour.title: Spill a dynamic array
tour.text: Type =SEQUENCE(4,2) into an empty cell, then sum its whole spilled output with a # reference to that cell, e.g. =SUM(A1#) for A1.

architecture.name: Workbook model
architecture.text: Sparse worksheets, A1 addressing, styles and data-tool definitions with no UI dependency.

architecture.name: Calculation
architecture.text: Bounded, non-eval formula parser and evaluator with dependency-based invalidation and virtual spill output.

architecture.name: Editing and interchange
architecture.text: Transactional sessions, delta history and structural transforms, plus native/CSV/XLSX file handling.

architecture.name: Geometry and rendering
architecture.text: Sparse axis indexes and frozen-pane viewports feed viewport-culled SkiaSharp rendering.

architecture.name: Uno workbench
architecture.text: The embeddable SKCanvasElement grid and Office-style controls composed into the complete workbench.

boundaries: No VBA, PivotTables, Power Query, external-data refresh, add-ins or multiplayer editing
XLSX is a supported subset, not package-preserving; .xls, .xlsb and .xlsm are not supported
Bulk edits, sorts and conditional ranges cap at 100,000 cells; imports at 256 sheets and 32 MB
No LAMBDA, structured references or full Excel function parity; not for safety-critical calculations
Browser recovery is a single local slot per origin and profile, not a cloud backup
